steps.objective: Build the Doctor dashboard end-to-end for GAMBIT v0.1 — Rust IPC spawning `eidolons doctor` in the selected project's cwd, TS parser converting the glyph-anchored stderr output into a structured check array (✓ pass, ✗ fail, · warn), and a 9-row React dashboard rendering each check with status badge + verbose details on expand. Wire palette 'Doctor' command to invoke. A parallel Agent A branch (feat/v0.1-routes) owns the route scaffolding and ships a DoctorRoute stub — this branch's DoctorRoute.tsx overrides Agent A's stub on merge with the real dashboard content. Per SPECTRA spec GAP-03: `eidolons doctor` has no --json flag; we parse stderr text. Maintain golden-test fixtures in tests/parsers/.

owned_files: src-tauri/src/lib.rs (registration of doctor module + start_doctor handler)
src/routes/DoctorRoute.tsx (real content — overrides parallel branch stub)
